chapter: New Orleans scene and jazz club
title: Marlis S., George Wagner and Bourbon spots
summary: Who is playing where in the Quarter and uptown today.

story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I never did catch a band. I keep going back and there's never any band. I'll be doing it. And with George Wagner.
I guess you heard of George Wagner. I heard of him, but I don't know. He's a drum player. Where did Marlis S. get to play?
He plays over soirees on a Sunday night. That's on St. Rock and Benefit. I thought they had the Duchess there.
No, she's there on Friday and Saturday.
Oh, and Escat comes in for the jam session? No, she has to work, so she takes off that night.

Same band, huh? Yeah, and then Escat is over on a Friday or Saturday. So, about the Silky side. That's on St. Peter and Toulouse. Somebody has a next section there on the far there. Right by the same time, huh? Yeah, there's a funeral home next door there.
That's good in case they have any trouble. Yeah, they do.
